name: Kaguya
source:
A fox goddess who protects the country. She has watched over and cared for the people since time immemorial.

Possesses a voluptuousness and enticing beauty that is unbefitting of a goddess.

[From [url=https://www.miel-soft.com/cheatkinbaku.html]official site[/url]]
